sentiment: Even in stillness the brain keeps its waves — nothing alive is ever truly quiet.

stories.title: Surprisingly complex waves reveal the brain's inner workings
stories.summary: The brain at rest is not idle — it is a field of travelling waves whose crossings carry the signal. What looks like calm is really motion that never stops, and the meaning lives in how the wavefronts meet.

stories.title: Halfspace: experimental IDE for solid modeling with distance fields
stories.summary: An idea that every solid is only a distance away from empty space — define the gap and the shape appears. Quiet arithmetic underneath, rippling outward until a surface emerges where the numbers agree.
